verdict.rationale: Convertio is a cloud file-conversion SaaS, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only a REST API, a CLI and PHP wrappers. These are developer building blocks someone could use to build an MCP integration, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit. Nothing in the pack mentions MCP, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.
